Concept bank: the tokenizer and its tokens

4 of the 90 concepts, of the family “illustrated, style B”, atoms first. Style B, “flat with light”, validated by the author on 22 October 2026: the people, the AI system, island 1.1’s use-case documents, and landmark (b)’s textual data, its domains and the concentration bar; landmark (c)’s absent model, translator, test and balance, and landmark (d)’s benchmark, its stations and the two French models, validated on 23 October 2026. Drawn with world/illustration/ (the look, the equipment, the paper). Each specimen is drawn by its function with the arguments of the calibration sheet he validated, alone, at whole size (a person is 360 units tall), at 1/3 and at 1/20, then its states and variants at 1/2.

token_bead

validated 23 October 2026 by the author ("Validated")

A token: one piece of a line of text, a capsule of the line's own ink, round where a word ends and cut on a clean slant, its fresh face glowing, where a blade went through a word.

Where: island 2.2, landmark (a), tokenizer training: the tokens each tokenizer spills out.

tokenized_line

validated 23 October 2026 by the author ("Validated")

A tokenized line: one line of text cut into its tokens, set in a row with a small gap between them, a wider one between words.

tokenizer

validated 23 October 2026 by the author ("Validated")

The tokenizer: the model's first part, which cuts text into tokens, drawn as a small board of the model's make with a slot where a line goes in, a comb of blades over a window that cuts it, and a slot where its tokens come out.

Where: island 2.2, landmark (a), tokenizer training: two of them side by side, one trained on general French text, one on TransCorpus.
